findings.current: I felt even more nervous than I had when facing Chairman Shao Yang.
findings.defect: Xiao Yang is incorrectly called Shao Yang, conflating his name with Shao Shen's.
findings.rationale: The chapter and binding terminology establish the state chairman's name as Xiao Yang.
findings.replacement: I felt even more nervous than I had when facing Chairman Xiao Yang.

findings.current: The Chengdu International Airport’s monster army was controlled by three incomplete Arch Liches, all destroyed by Taekyung and the Skeleton Warlord.
findings.defect: The three controllers are incorrectly identified as incomplete Arch Liches. They were incomplete Liches serving a separate Arch Lich.
findings.rationale: Chapter 381 explicitly states that they had not yet completed their transformation into Liches and served the Arch Lich; calling them Arch Liches collapses the established hierarchy.
findings.replacement: The Chengdu International Airport’s monster army was controlled by three incomplete Liches serving an Arch Lich, all destroyed by Taekyung and the Skeleton Warlord.

findings.current: The Chengdu International Airport attack involved an undead army controlled by three incomplete Arch Liches, all of whom Taekyung destroyed.
findings.defect: The active state incorrectly records the three controllers as incomplete Arch Liches rather than incomplete Liches serving an Arch Lich.
findings.rationale: This terminology error would propagate a false equivalence between the three subordinate necromancers and their Arch Lich master into later continuity.
findings.replacement: The Chengdu International Airport attack involved an undead army controlled by three incomplete Liches serving an Arch Lich, all of whom Taekyung destroyed.

findings.current: Taekyung discovers that nearly half the army consists of undead controlled by an unidentified force.
findings.defect: “Nearly half” means slightly less than half, while Chapter 380 states that roughly half or more of the army is undead.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the chapter's stated estimate without narrowing it in the opposite direction.
findings.replacement: Taekyung discovers that roughly half or more of the army consists of undead controlled by an unidentified force.

summary: The reading copies and state are broadly consistent in voice, formatting, and continuity. Four actionable issues remain: one character-name typo, two instances that incorrectly elevate the incomplete Liches to Arch Liches, and one summary quantity that conflicts with the chapter.
